name: Plume
size: small, no bigger than her forearm
look: a pearl-white dove with soft dove-grey wingtips, a faint warm champagne ring around each dark eye and a long fanned tail, a gentle pearl glow in its breast feathers
temperament: Calm and watchful; it speaks in low, rolling coos and carries her messages without being asked
scenePlacement: perched on her raised hand, wings half open, a loose white feather drifting down
notes: Test-bed creature for Angel Primes; never a dragon (the Elder Dragons are the Drakn line). Use it to try creature art, then move what works into the main roster.
